metadata.title: Netflix’s Business Model Faces Challenges. What the Alternative?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
If Netflix Can’t Shine in Show Business, Who Can?
In a recent episode of “Let’s Go to the Comments,” or whatever you want to call it, the camera looks down as a man opens a bathroom drawer to show off his cologne collection, but never mind that. The real stars of the 56-second production, captured inadvertently in the background, are his wayward, unruly toes. We freeze on a close up of them as the music stirs and the comments appear one by one, sung in a country twang: “Do they make Invisalign for toes?” One toe must have Covid, because “they are all social distancing.” “Bros toes are throwing gang signs.” “None of the little piggies stayed home.”
